source.authoredBasis: The written original has no image. Each radius180 in user space represents3cm with a declared60-user-unit centimeter. Sector fills use exact circular arcs,not chord polygons. R/G denote source red/green categories explicitly; semantic accent fills are modern display aids,not claims of literal source pigment. Unequal divisions and a fourth red sector are intentional alternatives,not original facts. Center and boundary point markers are visible new construction aids; they do not add source givens or change any coordinate.

authoritativeText.text: 254. 画一个半径为3厘米的圆。把这个圆分成8等份。其中的一份涂成绿色，三份涂成红色。这个圆的几分之几是红色？几分之几是绿色？
要画半径3厘米的圆，八等分后将三份涂红、一份涂绿，其余不涂。图中R表示红、G表示绿，未标记的部分不涂色。哪份完整构造和红、绿面积占比的记录同时正确？
